model_output.score_comment_short: Recent roles show concrete office responsibilities and scale, though key processes need detail.
model_output.score_comment_long: The law office role names the firm size, billing volume, staff supervision, and software transition. The dental role also gives useful practice and training details. Shorter bullets explaining how you handled reconciliation and claims follow-up would make the work easier to assess.
model_output.score_plain: Your resume gives a reviewer a substantive picture of office management in professional practices. The current paragraph format makes some of that detail slower to find.
model_output.first_impression: You manage a six-attorney firm's front office, billing, deadlines, and reception staff. The move from paper files to software for all new matters is worth keeping because it shows a change in how the firm handled its work.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "worked the insurance claims aging report each week" doesn't explain what you did with overdue claims, leaving the extent of your follow-up unclear.
model_output.summary: Your current Office Manager role combines attorney scheduling and court deadlines with billing, bookkeeping, vendor contracts, and staff supervision. The monthly trust account reconciliation distinguishes the financial work from general office administration. Earlier work in a dental practice adds insurance claims and patient-facing operations. The resume supports an office manager-level read, though the dense paragraphs make it less clear which tasks involved resolving exceptions or improving a process.
strengths: Roughly 90 client invoices a month gives a reviewer a useful sense of the billing workload.
Hiring and supervising two receptionists makes your staff responsibilities explicit.
Training three new front desk staff over four years shows that your dental office work included preparing others for the job.
gaps: The resume doesn't explain what you did to onboard the practice management software, so your contribution to the transition is difficult to distinguish from the software change itself.
The trust reconciliation is named, but the resume doesn't describe how you handled discrepancies, which would help explain the bookkeeping work.
The long experience paragraphs make court deadlines, billing, and supervision compete for attention during a quick read.
